LAW AND MOTION 301, THE MATTER WAS FIRST CALLED AT 9:30 WITH NO APPEARANCE FROM THE PLAINTIFF. DEFENDANT WAS SEARCHING FOR THE PROOF OF SERVICE THAT WAS FILED EARLIER TODAY AND THE MATTER WAS PASSED. ON THE SECOND CALL OF THE MATTER AROUND 11:05 A.M., THE PLAINTIFF WAS PRESENT IN COURT FOR THE EX-PARTE CALENDAR HEARING AND WAS CONTESTING THE PROOF OF SERVICE OR THE MANNER IT WAS SERVED. DEFENDANT ULISES CAMPOS' MOTION TO SET ASIDE DEFAULT AND DEFAULT JUDGMENT WAS HELD IN ABEYANCE FOR THE EX PARTE CALENDAR. AN ORDER SHORTENING TIME FILED AUGUST 25, 2009 TO HEAR DEFENDANT ULISES CAMPOS MOTION TO SET ASIDE DEFAULT AND DEFAULT JUDGMENT IS CONTINUED TO SEPTEMBER 1, 2009, AT 9:30 A.M. IN DEPT. 301.
